MOD = 998244353

def count_valid_colorings(n: int, m: int) -> int:
    """Count proper colorings of an n-person cycle using m colors, modulo MOD."""
    x = m - 1
    return (pow(x, n, MOD) + (x if n % 2 == 0 else -x)) % MOD
